question: Why can non-being be treated as having a positive nature?
premises: All beings have their own nature
Non-being can be understood in terms of being
inference: Because non-being too has the nature of all beings, it is treated as being.
uncertainties: The metaphysical sense of non-being having nature is compressed
plain_english: Because non-being too has the nature of all things, it is treated as a kind of being.
